intro: The Golden Visa programme, granted for purchasing property from 250,000 euros, provides a 5-year residence permit with the right to work and study. After 7 years comes EU citizenship.
climate: Mediterranean: hot, dry summers of +30-40°C and mild, rainy winters of +12-18°C. The islands are warmer, the mountains cooler.
mentality: A hospitable Mediterranean culture, a slow pace of life, and the philosophy of philotimo (respect and generosity towards one's neighbour).
language_note: Greek is the official language. In Athens, Thessaloniki and the resorts English is enough, but Greek is needed for healthcare and schooling.
visa_note: A Schengen visa or residence permit is required. The most popular routes: the Golden Visa (from 250,000 euros) and the Digital Nomad Visa (income from 3,500 euros per month).
